hand.name: Jumpy Dumpty
hand.description: Deal 8 damage to random enemies twice. Place a Bomb dealing 6 damage. Burst +5. Applies Pyro. Elemental Skill.

keywords.name: Bomb
keywords.description: Detonates at the start of your turn or early when its enemy takes unblocked Attack damage. The first attack that enemy makes while Bombed each combat deals 25% less damage.

keywords.name: Burst Energy
keywords.description: Burst Energy: your character's meter, empty at the start of each combat. Playing a card with Elemental Skill grants 5 and every Elemental Reaction grants 5; some cards, powers and relics grant more. The moment the meter is FULL your character's Burst card is put into your hand, and casting it spends the WHOLE meter -- energy past full is lost at the cast, not at the gain. You hold 0 of 40 Burst Energy.

keywords.name: Elemental Skill
keywords.description: Playing this card grants 5 Burst Energy.
